title: Cadet Engineer
abstract: Turn what you are learning into practical engineering experience that supports communities and protects the environment.
bullets: Flexible work to help you balance study, work and life
Gain hands on experience across water and wastewater treatment
uild your career with mentoring, development and Veolia benefits
content_text:
START YOUR ENGINEERING CAREER WITH PURPOSE
Veolia is seeking a Cadet Engineer to join its water team in Woronora 2232. This is a two year, part time opportunity, working three days per week—ideal for gaining practical experience while building your engineering career.
Working alongside experienced engineers and operational teams, you will gain practical experience across water and wastewater treatment plants. You will contribute to data analysis, reporting, process investigations and improvement projects while developing valuable industry skills.
WHAT'S ON OFFER
 - Flexible working arrangements to help balance study, work and life
 - Practical experience across operational treatment plants
 - Mentoring, professional development and future career opportunities
 - Employee share plan, Fitness Passport and Bupa health insurance discount
 - Paid volunteer day and confidential wellbeing support
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Collect and analyse operational data
 - Help prepare operational, contractual and regulatory reports
 - Track compliance and sustainability performance
 - Support process investigations, troubleshooting and optimisation
 - Assist with plant upgrades and improvement projects
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
 - Currently studying, or recently completed, a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
 - An interest in building a career in the water industry
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills
 - Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn
BUILD YOUR FUTURE WITH VEOLIA
Veolia is a global environmental services business delivering essential water, waste and energy services. You will join a supportive team, learn from experienced people and have opportunities to build a longer term career with Veolia.
READY TO GET STARTED?
Apply now to begin building practical engineering experience in an industry that makes a difference every day.
Veolia is committed to a fair, respectful and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, veterans, people with disability, people of all genders and ages, members of LGBTIQA+ communities and people from all cultural backgrounds.
